# frontegg_custom_code_prehook (Resource)

Configures a Frontegg custom code prehook that runs JavaScript on Frontegg's side.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "frontegg_custom_code_prehook" "example" {
  enabled     = true
  name        = "Example custom code prehook"
  description = "An example of a custom code prehook"
  runtime     = "NODE_20"
  timeout     = 10
  events = [
    "SIGN_UP"
  ]
  fail_method = "CLOSE"

  code = <<-EOT
    async function onEvent(eventData) {
      return {
        verdict: 'allow',
      };
    }

    exports.onEvent = onEvent;
  EOT
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `code` (String) The JavaScript source that handles the event. It must define and export an `onEvent` handler.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the prehook is enabled.
- `events` (Set of String) The name of the event to subscribe to. Custom code prehooks support exactly one event.
- `fail_method` (String) The action to take when the prehook fails.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A human-readable description of the prehook.
- `name` (String) A human-readable name for the prehook.
- `runtime` (String) The runtime to execute the code with (e.g. `NODE_20`).
- `timeout` (Number) The execution timeout in seconds.

### Read-Only

- `executor_identifier` (String) The identifier of the custom code executor backing this prehook.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
